scenes.text: Replace the letter with the given number, then use the order of operations.
Evaluate 2n plus 8 if n equals 8. The answer is 24. Substitute n equals 8 to obtain 2 times 8 plus 8 equals 24.
A display at a school fair uses rule 9n plus 8. What is the display when n equals 2? Pause to choose and explain.
A display at a school fair uses rule 9n plus 8. What is the display when n equals 2? The answer is 26. Substitute n equals 2 to obtain 9 times 2 plus 8 equals 26.
